notes: Haggle for taxis (Naama to Old Market 100-150 EGP) or use the hotel shuttle; Uber/Careem are limited. The airport is 15 minutes away. Tours leave from your hotel (Ras Mohammed, Tiran, Sinai, safari).
November to March is sunny at 22-25°C (Europe's winter refuge), the sea is 21-23°C and nights are cool. The Sinai summit can hit -5°C with snow in winter. January is the busiest month.
Sinai visa: a free 15-day "Sinai only" stamp covers Sharm, Dahab and Sinai alone; you can't go on to Cairo. Turkish citizens can get an e-visa or a visa on arrival for 25 USD.
Tour prices in USD: Ras Mohammed 40-60, Tiran 50, Sinai 40, safari 35-60, trial dive 90. Restaurants 200-400 EGP; tip 20-50 EGP everywhere.
Don't step on the coral: it's banned and fined. Use reef-friendly sun cream and bring water shoes. Women can dress casually in the resort, but cover up in the Old Market.
Sinai calamari, Egyptian breakfast (ful, taameya), koshari and umm ali dessert. Alcohol is served in hotels.

stops.name: Naama Bay Beach
stops.tips: The heart of the resort, set in a bay: hotel beaches and house-reef snorkelling (northern end of the bay). Cooler in the morning.

stops.name: Naama Bay Promenade
stops.tips: A pedestrian promenade with cafés, shisha and shops where you can haggle.

stops.name: Fares Seafood Naama
stops.tips: Sharm's best-known seafood: pick from the counter, priced by the kilo. Try the Sinai calamari.

stops.name: Hotel Pool / Siesta
stops.tips: It's 24°C in winter, so stay by the shore. The sea is 22°C.

stops.name: SOHO Square
stops.tips: Dancing fountain, ice bar and Culturama: the place for an evening out.

backups.name: El Masrien Grill Naama
backups.tips: Egyptian grill with kofta and chicken, a local favourite.

backups.name: Sharm Old Market
backups.tips: The old market: spices, papyrus and haggling, plus the Al Sahaba Mosque (lit up at night).

stops.name: Ras Mohammed National Park
stops.tips: At the tip of Sinai (30 minutes by boat or car). One of the world's best diving and snorkelling spots. Park fee about 15 USD.

stops.name: Shark Reef & Yolanda Reef
stops.tips: Wall reefs with Napoleon wrasse and barracuda, plus the toilets from the wrecked Yolanda.

stops.name: Mangrove Channel & Enchanted Lagoon
stops.tips: A mangrove channel and a salty "magic lake" formed by an earthquake.

stops.name: Lunch on the Boat
stops.tips: Included in the tour: grilled fish and rice.

stops.name: Marsa Bareika Bay
stops.tips: A calm bay for snorkelling and the beach. Return at 16:00.

backups.name: Ras Um Sid Reef
backups.tips: A headland reef within the city (Hadaba). If you have no boat, enjoy the view from Farsha Café.

backups.name: Farsha Café Ras Um Sid
backups.tips: A clifftop café with Bedouin rugs: sunset and shisha.

stops.name: Mount Sinai Night Climb
stops.tips: 3 hours from Sharm (tour leaves at 22:00). Moses' Ten Commandments mountain, 2,285 m: camel path plus 750 steps, sunrise, -5°C in winter, so wear a heavy coat.

stops.name: Summit Chapel at Sunrise
stops.tips: The Holy Trinity chapel, as Sinai's red mountains light up.

stops.name: Steps of Repentance Descent
stops.tips: 3,750 steps of the monks' path (Elijah's Basin). Watch your knees.

stops.name: Saint Catherine's Monastery
stops.tips: A 6th-century UNESCO monastery (the world's oldest working monastery): the Burning Bush, Moses' Well and icons. It may be closed on Fridays and Sundays.

stops.name: Bedouin Breakfast in St Catherine Village
stops.tips: Tea, bread and honey in a Bedouin tent. Return at 15:00 (afternoon nap).

backups.name: Dahab Blue Hole
backups.tips: Instead of Sinai: snorkel at Dahab's legendary 100 m blue hole (Bells), a hippie town, 1.5 hours away.

stops.name: Tiran Island Boat Trip
stops.tips: 1 hour by boat from Sharm (tour about 50 USD). The island at the mouth of the Gulf of Aqaba has 4 reefs (Jackson, Woodhouse, Thomas, Gordon).

stops.name: Jackson Reef Snorkelling
stops.tips: A colourful coral garden with turtles and the wrecked Lara.

stops.name: Lunch on the Boat at Tiran
stops.tips: Lunch on deck, included.

stops.name: Gordon Reef Swim
stops.tips: A shallow coral plateau where the Loullia wreck is visible. Return at 15:30.

stops.name: Naama Bay Sunset Walk
stops.tips: Promenade and sea in the evening.

backups.name: White Island
backups.tips: A sandbar island that appears at low tide. An alternative to the Ras Mohammed tour.

backups.name: Camel Bar Naama
backups.tips: The rooftop bar of Camel Dive Club: chat with the divers.

stops.name: Wadi Mandar Quad Safari
stops.tips: 1.5 hours by ATV/quad in the Sinai desert. Expect dust, so bring goggles.

stops.name: Bedouin Village Visit
stops.tips: Bedouin tea and bread baking, plus a short camel ride.

stops.name: Hotel Lunch & Siesta
stops.tips: Escape the midday heat with the pool and lunch.

stops.name: Desert Sunset & Stargazing Tour
stops.tips: Camels, a Bedouin dinner and stars through a telescope (no light pollution). Tour.

backups.name: Colored Canyon Nuweiba
backups.tips: A walk through a colourful rock canyon (2.5 hours' drive). A full day instead of the safari.

backups.name: Bedouin Dinner Camp
backups.tips: Lamb and rice, included in the tour.

stops.name: Discover Scuba Diving Naama
stops.tips: A trial dive (no certificate needed, 12 m with an instructor). Camel/Emperor Divers; Red Sea visibility 30 m.

stops.name: Lunch at the Dive Centre Café
stops.tips: After the dive: sandwiches.

stops.name: Sharm Aquarium / Old Market
stops.tips: In the afternoon, the market and Al Sahaba Mosque. Haggle.

stops.name: Al Fanar Ras Um Sid
stops.tips: Italian cuisine and seafood on the cliff, with the lighthouse and sunset.

backups.name: Dahab Lighthouse Reef & Town
backups.tips: A Dahab day: snorkel at Lighthouse and visit the seafront cafés, 1.5 hours away.

backups.name: Hard Rock Cafe Naama
backups.tips: An evening alternative with live music.

days.theme: Last swim and a gentle farewell

stops.name: Shark's Bay
stops.tips: A bay near the airport with a house reef and jetty. Your last swim.

stops.name: Hotel Breakfast
stops.tips: A long breakfast. Keep your cabin bag with you.

stops.name: Sharm Old Market
stops.tips: Spices, dates and alabaster. Haggle.

stops.name: Sharm El Sheikh International Airport
stops.tips: 15 minutes from Naama. Farewell.

backups.name: Il Mercato Hadaba
backups.tips: An open-air mall, instead of the market.

backups.name: Tam Tam Naama
backups.tips: Egyptian breakfast: ful (fava bean stew) and taameya (falafel).
